analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($338.39) vs SMA5($330.75)/SMA20($328.37)/SMA50($309.08): Confirmed above short-term and mid-term trends.
· High position relative to SMA100($257.18)/SMA200($222.31): Maintaining strong long-term trend.
· 52-week position (82.7%) + Current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 54.1 → 57.1 (exiting oversold): Strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram -1.4918 → -1.3838 (improving): Signal of weakening bearishness and bottoming.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near mid-band $328.38): Bandwidth at 12.40%, indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($303.89): Strong support zone based on 20-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($341.95): Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low): Signal of strengthening uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.05x): Recent price action confidence at normal levels.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry conditions met with 5-day low recovery and rising RSI.
